question: Can MileSplit supply Class-of-2027 athlete identities without Athletic.net?
verdict: YES — the roster path (/teams then /teams/<id>/roster) is robots-allowed on every host, HTML-only, carries a grad-year cell on every athlete row of a populated roster, needs no login or paywall, and enumerates a state's whole team universe with one request for the index
recommendation: PRIMARY for class-of-2027 identity, grade and school attribution; RESULT_SOURCE (/raw result files) and DISCOVERY_SOURCE (/teams, /results, /calendar, /search/v2/athletes) as declared secondary roles
